## Limits

- Three-site coherent scattering toy, not Kagome, chemistry, mechanical stress or hysteresis.
- Complex hopping requires an implementation mechanism; no fabrication or experimental validation.
- Distinct-onsite opposite flux is separated under gauge plus permutation; time reversal would identify it if included in the quotient.
- Symmetric +/-flux triangles are unlabelled reflection copies, although their fixed labelled-port responses differ.
- The four-arm table is deterministic routing replay. Token use is zero; behavioral/AI superiority is unmeasured.
- Distance fingerprints measure distinctions on these probes. Noise, shared sources and shared models limit any independence interpretation.
- First-pass worker context isolation is procedural, not an OS security boundary; H can inspect exported records.
- Shared schemas require separate human promotion; local forks coexist.
